headline: Evercore ISI Group Maintains Outperform on Akamai Technologies, Raises Price Target to $175
summary: Evercore ISI Group  analyst Amit Daryanani   maintains Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ:AKAM) with a Outperform and raises the price target from $165 to $175.
